description: Planes de Protección civil de Canet d'Adri is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by canet-adri.cat. he Canet d'Adri Civil Protection Plan aims to be the organic framework that coordinates the actions and response of the Public Services aimed at emergency response and care within the municipality. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Civil protection plans of Canet d'Adri" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Protecció civil, Fire, Canet d'Adri, Risc sísmic, Riesgo sísmico, Civil protection. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
